thread:
alice.k: kicking off the air-gapped PV bring-up for customer-phi, region: eu-central. goal: validate GPU pool + network SLA + telemetry before handoff. short checklist below.

alice.k: preflight I/O: drivers, nv_peer_mem, gds; registry sync done to local mirror.

bob_net: confirmed firewall ACLs for customer egress. blocked ports opened for seed hosts (443, 5000). need NAT allocation for outbound mirror pulls.

carol_sre: can we keep initial traffic shaping to 10Gbps egress to respect their NOC limits? will throttle on the LB side.

dave_delivery: customer asked about latency SLO: 99th <= 120ms intra-cluster for inference p95 target 50ms. we should run 1h synthetic before canary.

alice.k: plan: 1) bootstrap nodes (k8s 1.27), 2) GPU driver + containerd config, 3) mirror images pull, 4) deploy infra services, 5) run burn-in tests + latency bench, 6) handoff.

bob_net: note on routing: private subnets use customer-provided BGP. during bootstrap we'll use static routes to seed IPs. verify BGP flap tolerance prior to scale.

carol_sre: adding expected commands for sanity checks:
```
# check GPUs visible
nvidia-smi -L
# driver modules
lsmod | egrep 'nvidia|nv_peer_mem|gds'
# pod network
kubectl get pods -n redwood-system -o wide
```

alice.k: logs from a failing node earlier:
"kubelet: device plugin registration timeout"
we fixed by bumping node kernel param vm.max_map_count on init script.

dave_delivery: cost note: customer preferred reserved 8xA100 pool vs mixed spot. we estimated monthly delta ~+$28k for 20 nodes but guarantees capacity. put that in delivery doc.

bob_net: also watch cross-region egress: mirror sync from our eu-west archive to customer eu-central mirror will incur egress on our side; schedule during off-peak.

carol_sre: telemetry: enable minimal metrics (cpu/gpu/mem/net/latency) and only sample traces for failed requests to reduce bandwidth from airgap exporter. config snippet:
```yaml
telemetry:
  exporter: file
  sample_rate: 0.01
  metrics: [gpu_util,net_tx,net_rx,latency]
```

alice.k: runbook step to validate model KV cache consistency after warmup: call /health/cache?keys=sample_prompt and assert hit-rate >= 95% after 10k tokens.

dave_delivery: customer onboarding checklist item: KMS access test (HSM emulation) — completed by security team?

carol_sre: security confirmed offline KMS handshake works with provided token bundle. documented recovery steps in vault-sync playbook.

infra-bot: deploy-job #2123 started on seed-03. status: image-pull-from-local-mirror OK, kube-proxy ready. :rocket:

alice.k: running 1h synthetic load now (100 concurrent sessions, 16k tokens/session) — will post results. please keep slack pings to essentials.

bob_net: ping if you hit < 99th 120ms or driver OOMs. I'll watch BGP and NAT counters.

carol_sre: if burn-in passes, next step is canary (10% traffic) with automatic fallback to hosted. rollout window tomorrow 02:00-05:00 UTC.

dave_delivery: noted. I'll prep the handoff doc and cost breakdown for customer sign-off.

alice.k: thanks all — updates in ~65m with the synthetic results. :white_check_mark:
